units.source_text: 钟声还在持续不断地响着，但距离已经很远，稀稀拉拉。

en.t: The bell was still ringing on and on, but it was already very far away and sounded sparse and broken.

units.source_text: 狗叫也远了，听起来像是无可奈何的悲鸣。

en.t: The barking of the dogs had also grown distant, sounding like helpless cries of despair.

units.source_text: 现在搅乱周围空气的，倒是他自己的呼吸声，那种用平锉刀锉铸件的声音。

en.t: What disturbed the air around him now was instead the sound of his own breathing, like a flat file scraping over a casting.

units.source_text: 追兵的油灯，还是老样子，三个并排，上下摇曳，

en.t: The pursuers' oil lamps were still the same as before, three of them lined up side by side, bobbing up and down,

units.source_text: 既没有特别接近的样子，也没有特别疏远的样子。

en.t: showing no sign of coming especially closer, and no sign of falling especially farther behind.

units.source_text: 逃跑的一方，追击的一方，奔跑的难度是一样的。

en.t: For the one fleeing and for the ones pursuing, the difficulty of running was the same.

units.source_text: 以后，可就是耐力问题了。

en.t: From here on, it would be a question of endurance.

units.source_text: 这一点上，也不能说放心。

en.t: On that point, too, he could not say he felt reassured.

units.source_text: 也许因为过于持续的紧张关系，不，可能是意识里产生了断层，

en.t: Perhaps because the tension had gone on too long; no, perhaps because a rupture had opened in his consciousness,

units.source_text: 他心里忽然掠过一阵胆怯的情绪，像在企望更迅速地振作起来。

en.t: a sudden wave of timidity passed through him, as though he were wishing he could recover himself more quickly.

units.source_text: 对这个危险要是有所思想准备，那倒还不错……

en.t: If he had been mentally prepared for this danger, that would not have been so bad...
